scope: existing chronological development folds only; replay last development fold with its frozen artifacts
baselineReconstruction: one fixed original momentum baseline per pair on original training/calibration rows; not a new candidate or tuning trial
baselinePolicy: preserve calibration-selected comparator and report every existing baseline; do not choose a comparator from validation scores
priceReplay: forbidden: deployment refits can contain development dates; use recorded walk-forward scores only
